description:
You are a senior .NET developer at Meridian Bank. The BankingCore transaction processing library was recently migrated from .NET Framework 4.5 to .NET 8, but the migration was mechanical — it still uses patterns from the old framework era that violate the bank's updated coding standards and have caused production reliability incidents. The BankingCore solution is already open in Visual Studio 2022.

Modernize the BankingCore library so that it uses current .NET 8 best practices throughout. The solution must build with 0 errors after your changes. Windows user: Docker, password: GymAnything123!
